verdict.rationale: Cursor documents outbound webhooks for cloud agent runs. When an agent is created with a webhook URL, Cursor POSTs HMAC-SHA256-signed statusChange events (ERROR/FINISHED) with a documented payload and verification snippets. However, this only exists on the legacy v0 API; the current v1 API says "Webhooks are coming soon," and the only event type is agent status change. Automations can be triggered by incoming webhooks, but that is inbound triggering rather than event subscription. Missing for 10: webhook support on the current v1 API, a broader event catalog beyond agent status changes (e.g. PR, Bugbot, usage or admin events), subscription management endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
